messages:
maria: heads up — seeing a steady spike in embed latency on prod eu-west1 after the last quant rollout. impact ~3% tail latency, 5xxs up 0.3%. requesting fastpatch deploy.
jamal: can you paste the failing telemetry link?
maria: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embed/eu-west1 — spike started at 16:10 UTC and correlates with model v2.3.1-quant.
lee: is this causing customer-visible errors? any SLA risk?
maria: small increase in error rate on large requests. not complete outage but noticeable for a few enterprise customers on high-seq workloads. recommend pin to v2.2.9 fallback and quick config tweak to batching window.
sre_oncall: if we do an expedited deploy we need: changelog entry, rollback command, owner, and a canary plan.
emily: tagging infra for capacity — @jamal please confirm we have capacity to land fallback without thrashing caches.
jamal: infra clear, canary slice 1% eu-west1, then 10% if metrics stable.
maria: release notes (draft):
```
Hotfix: revert embed model from v2.3.1-quant -> v2.2.9 in eu-west1 to mitigate increased tail latency and 5xxs. Rollback if errors increase after change.
```
lee: LGTM for note. who's making the call to launch? need explicit approvals (ops + oncall).
sre_oncall: I approve roll to canary. jamal, you ok to trigger and monitor?
jamal: yes, I'll trigger canary and watch p50/p95/p99 + 5xxs.
maria: deploybot, start deploy: image=embed-service:v2.2.9 pin=eu-west1 slice=1% by=jamal
deploybot: @jamal started deploy run id: dr-1764123456-a. Strategy: staged canary -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%, checks: healthchecks(30s), p95 latency, 5xx rate.
emily: noted — routing and infra alerts enabled. ops channel on for manual rollback.
lee: rollback plan (one-liner):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.1-quant && kubectl rollout status deploy/embed-service -n prod
```
lee: if 5xxs > 0.5% or p95 regresses > 20% for 5m, abort and rollback.
maria: ack. I've posted the release note + changelog to the release board. tagging @sre_oncall for final watch.
sre_oncall: monitoring windows set. if canary passes for 15m, proceed to 10%.
jamal: canary 1% started. logs: `dr-1764123456-a: canary start`. watching.
jamal: 5m in — p95 down 18%, 5xx stable at baseline. green to 10%.
deploybot: progressing deploy to 10% slice.
emily: notifying customers via status page that we're performing a mitigation deploy (no expected downtime).
maria: thanks team. will follow up with postmortem link once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
jamal: final note — tagging release notes as hotfix/critical so billing & change-logs reflect expedited window.
